scope: 9c n8 tbl-p0036-01 figure only; independent source-first review

source.method: Direct observation of the original native crop; literal transcription, not formula reconstruction.

geometry.arrangement: Left-aligned increasing triangle; each successive row has one additional printed value at its right.
geometry.indexColumn: Separate left column, all eleven indices to the left of a single vertical divider.
geometry.rowOrder: Top to bottom: literal indices 0 through 10.
geometry.valueOrder: Left to right as transcribed, with the first value aligned across all rows.
sourceRelationships: Every printed label is inside the outer frame.
Every index is left of the index divider.
Every value is right of the index divider.
Values in each row are in strictly increasing horizontal positions.
Rows are in strictly increasing vertical positions.
The first-value column is approximately aligned, not centered as a whole triangle.
The upper-right remainder has no printed numeric entries or grid.
geometry.coordinateStatus: Visual estimates for orientation only, not measured pixel registration.

holds.observation: Thick irregular outer ink border, small breaks and uneven edges, including the left edge near the bottom and bottom edge toward the right.
holds.limit: Do not silently treat an ideal rectangle as exact source ink preservation.

holds.observation: The vertical index divider has roughness and a short rightward ink protrusion near the row indexed 5.
holds.limit: No evidence that this is a semantic tick; neither invent a tick nor claim exact ink preservation after removing it.

holds.observation: Printed glyphs have variable widths, baselines and damaged ink; the 9 near the right of row 9 is rough but legible as 9.
holds.limit: Numeral identities are readable; exact glyph-outline correspondence is not established.

holds.observation: Isolated specks and incidental ink occur within otherwise blank areas and near labels.
holds.limit: Do not reinterpret these as content or silently claim that blank semantic slots preserve all source pixels.
